item.title: Exclusive: Pentagon sends ‘political loyalty’ survey to US allies
item.description: In a questionnaire, the Pentagon presented a list of questions to 31 NATO allies to determine ‘loyalty’ to the US.

item.title: At least 6 killed in multiple Russian missile strikes across Ukraine
item.description: Russian ballistic missiles killed at least six people and ⁠injured over two dozen more in Kyiv early on Thursday.

item.title: Trump vows ‘economic warfare’ on countries helping Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened ‘economic D-Day’ on any countries that help or do business with Iran.

item.title: Russian forces kill 6 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy faces pressure over elections
item.description: Russian ballistic missile attacks hit at least three districts in Kyiv, collapsing buildings and causing fires.

item.title: Fears grow in Amazon village as Brazilian drug gangs push into Bolivia
item.description: Fears are growing in a remote Bolivian village as Brazilian drug gangs fight for control of trafficking routes.

item.title: Alarm in South Korea as Iran dispute with Trump shakes a 72-year alliance
item.description: Trump's order to scale back military drills rattles Seoul, reviving doubts over US security guarantees.

item.title: Bodycam captures police team falling when deck collapses in Missouri
item.description: Recently released body camera footage shows a deck collapsing during a warrant operation in Huntsville, Missouri.

item.title: Publisher of US military newspaper resigns over differences with government
item.description: Retirement of longtime Stars and Stripes publisher comes amid the Trump administration's push for editorial control.

item.title: ‘Tsunami’ of emigration reshapes Israel’s future, experts warn
item.description: Nearly 270,000 Israelis have left the country over three years, citing political uncertainty and security concerns.

item.title: Harry Kane scores goal by winning Golden Shoe for the second time
item.description: English footballer Harry Kane won the title of ‘Europe’s best goalscorer’, awarded the Golden Shoe for the second time.

item.title: Nigeria’s election campaign begins with Tinubu facing a reform test
item.description: Rising costs fuel anger, but President Bola Tinubu’s machinery and opposition divisions may shape the race.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump announces ‘most crushing’ Iran sanctions
item.description: Trump says Washington may resume talks with Tehran 'at some point'.

item.title: US national debt passes record $40 trillion
item.description: The amount has doubled in the last decade, from Trump's first term through the Biden administration.

item.title: ‘We do not trust Israeli judiciary’ says Hind Rajab’s grandmother
item.description: The grandmother of Hind Rajab, a five-year-old Palestinian girl killed in her family’s car by Israeli forces in Gaza.

item.title: Kosovo finds remains of 23 people in mass graves search
item.description: The discovery is part of Kosovo’s long-running effort to find people who disappeared during a brutal war in the 1990s.

item.title: South Korea’s rookie investors lose small fortunes amid AI stocks frenzy
item.description: South Korea's stock market has attracted a wave of novice investors amid booming demand for chips used in AI.

item.title: International body votes to convene emergency meeting over Nicaragua
item.description: Nicaragua's move to extend Ortega's rule and bar rivals from elections triggers a near-unanimous OAS rebuke.

item.title: Pentagon quizzes NATO allies on political loyalty, documents reveal
item.description: NATO allies probed on loyalty to US policies in Pentagon questionnaire obtained exclusively by Al Jazeera.

item.title: Lebanon hands former Syrian army general to Damascus after arrest warrant
item.description: The transfer is the first from Lebanon involving a Syrian military officer who fled after al-Assad's government fell.

item.title: Trump announces ‘most crushing economic operation ever’ against Iran
item.description: US president announces 'economic operation' against Iran, promises measures against nations trading with Tehran.

item.title: What the social media addiction lawsuit could cost Meta
item.description: Landmark trial against Meta could lead to fines and fundamental changes in Facebook and Instagram's operations.

item.title: Trump says he plans to meet Kim Jong Un later this year
item.description: US President Donald Trump praised his relationship with North Korea’s leader Kim Jong Un.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza City police headquarters kills women’s police chief
item.description: An Israeli strike on Gaza City’s police headquarters has killed the women’s police chief and several officers.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese watch southern Lebanon’s ‘pilot zones’ from afar
item.description: “You can't do anything. Just stand here and watch.” Al Jazeera’s Ali Hashem watched Israeli attacks near his home town.

item.title: Israel orders inquiry into killing of 6-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza
item.description: The Israeli military announced criminal investigations into the killings of six-year-old Hind Rajab.
